TARGET: kind=title → the post title; kind=excerpt → the opening public excerpt of the post (starts with `locator`). Quotes of others, third-party trades, examples, price reports and questions are NOT claims. No own view → labels: []. Cannot open/find → note 'unavailable'; genuinely unclear → ambiguous=true; ticker not verifiable → 'needs_article_check'. Never guess. Answer per blind_id: {blind_id, labels:[{symbol,stance,status,instrument,holder,ticker_source}], ambiguous, note}.
